buildbar.roomsBody: Pick a room, then drag it out on the map. {n} of {total} rooms unlocked.
buildbar.roomsBodyActive: Placing: {room}. Click to pick a different room.
buildbar.staffBody: {n} staff on the payroll. Wages: {wages} coins a day.
buildbar.demolishBody: Click a room to tear it down. You get {pct} % of its price back – all of it right after building.
buildbar.demolishOn: Demolish is on. Click again or right-click to stop.
buildbar.closeBody: Close this menu. The game keeps running.
buildbar.roomsHint: Click a room, then drag on the map.
buildbar.roomsHintTouch: Tap a room, then drag on the map.
buildbar.lockTunnel: Unlocks after the first Spoon Tunnel
buildbar.eff.bunk: Rascals sleep here: +{n} energy per hour. Each bed pays {c} coin board per hour.
buildbar.eff.canteen: Fills hungry tummies. Each seat serves {n} meals per hour; one cook runs {s} seats.
buildbar.eff.wash: Keeps rascals fresh: one shower gives +{n} hygiene.
buildbar.eff.workshop: Each station knits a crate every {h} h ({c} coins) and adds +{r} reform per hour. One foreman runs {s} stations.
buildbar.eff.classroom: Each desk adds +{n} reform per hour. One teacher teaches {s} desks.
buildbar.eff.guard: Fewer escapes and scuffles within {r} tiles. Needs a guard.
buildbar.eff.yard: Fun in the fresh air: +{n} fun per hour for each spot.
buildbar.wageBody: Paid every midnight. A wage rises with the level of the room they work in.
buildbar.hireBody: One-off fee: {fee} coins, then {wage} coins wage every midnight. Starts at the {room}.
buildbar.hireBodyRoam: One-off fee: {fee} coins, then {wage} coins wage every midnight.
buildbar.does.janitor: Scrubs the dirtiest room: +{n} clean per hour
buildbar.does.clerk: Stamps a release every {n} s at the gate
buildbar.does.carter: Carts {n} crates per trip to the dock
buildbar.more.cook: Without a cook, the Canteen serves nothing.
buildbar.more.janitor: Without one, rooms only freshen up overnight.
buildbar.more.guard: Catches escapees and calms scuffles with a whistle.
buildbar.more.teacher: Without a teacher, class is cancelled.
buildbar.more.foreman: Stations without a foreman knit at {n} % speed.
buildbar.more.carter: Without a cart driver, crates pile up.
buildbar.landTip: The fence falls and the island grows by {w}×{h} tiles.
buildbar.landConfirmTip: Tap twice to buy – the first tap asks, the second one pays.
